findings.evidence: `rw [..., hfun', hsrc, preimage_comp]` then `rfl`: after `hfun'` the RHS coordinate map is `(χ.extendTrans .. ∘ g) ∘ u ∘ φ.symm`, but the LHS is `χ.extendTrans .. ∘ (g ∘ u) ∘ φ.symm`.
findings.fix: Add `Function.comp_assoc` (or `Function.comp_def`) to the rewrite chain so the goal closes syntactically, or comment what the `rfl` identifies.
findings.issue: `isWeakCauchyRiemannOn_chart_diffeomorph_comp_iff` ends its `rw` chain with a bare, uncommented `rfl` that closes `(χe ∘ g) ∘ u ∘ φ.symm` against `χe ∘ (g ∘ u) ∘ φ.symm` by definitional equality (associativity of composition).

findings.evidence: Diffeomorph/Basic.lean:171 `mfderiv_comp_diffeomorph ... = (mfderiv J K f (h x)).comp (mfderiv I J h x)`: the leftover goal is exactly `comp_apply`.
findings.fix: Use `rw [g.mfderiv_comp_diffeomorph hr, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]` (and the same for `h2`) instead of the trailing `rfl`.
findings.issue: `h1` and `h2` in `chartField_pullback` close with uncommented `rfl` after `rw [g.mfderiv_comp_diffeomorph hr]` / `rw [g.symm.mfderiv_diffeomorph_comp hr]`, relying on the definitional unfolding of `ContinuousLinearMap.comp` application.

findings.evidence: The in-code comments state that the only mismatch is the base point `(φ.symm z, y).2` vs `y` and `(g.symm ∘ ψ.symm) v` vs `y`, which `dsimp`/`Function.comp_apply` removes.
findings.fix: State `h2` at base point `y` (via `hy_def`/`Function.comp_apply`), or `dsimp only at h` / `simp only [Function.comp_apply] at h2` before rewriting, then use plain `rw`.
findings.issue: `erw [h2]` (and `erw [h]` in `InhomogeneousTerm.chartTerm_pullback`, Inhomogeneous/Pullback.lean ~line 257) is needed only because the hypothesis is stated at the unreduced base point `(g.symm ∘ ψ.symm) v` / `(φ.symm z, y).2`. `erw` matching up to defeq is brittle under Mathlib changes.

findings.evidence: The two `refine (isWeakCauchyRiemannOn_chart_diffeomorph_comp_iff g ?_ (fun x ↦ ?_) (fun w ↦ ?_) φ)` blocks are followed by identical `· ext x; simp · simp · simp`.
findings.fix: Close the side goals with `<;> simp [Set.ext_iff]`, or factor the source/apply/symm identities of `e.toPartialDiffeomorph.trans ψ` into one private lemma used by both branches.
findings.issue: Both branches of `isWeakPseudoholomorphicOn_diffeomorph_comp_iff` repeat the same three side-goal proofs (`ext x; simp`, `simp`, `simp`) for the chart identities of `g.symm.toPartialDiffeomorph.trans`/`g.toPartialDiffeomorph.trans`.

findings.evidence: `have key (D) (hD : D = 2 • id) (w) ... := by subst hD; simp only [...]; rw [smul_comm]` followed by `exact key _ hD v`.
findings.fix: Replace `key` with `rw [hD]; simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply]; exact smul_comm _ _ _`, or add a comment explaining why a direct `rw [hD]` fails (e.g. dependent tangent-space types).
findings.issue: In `pullback_twoSMulDiffeomorph_ofComplexManifold`, the local `key` lemma generalizes `D` only to `subst` it back. This roundabout step is undocumented and hides that the goal is just `smul_comm` after `rw [hD]`.

summary: Proofs build, but a few steps still close on undocumented definitional equality (a trailing `rfl` after a rewrite chain, bare `rfl`s after the composition rewrites) or use an `erw` that a reduction step would make unnecessary.
